**Round 158 = V-3a (D-29z123)**
- **One file only:** `ArrangementTransport.tsx`.
  - All 12 transport buttons lose their visible frame (the 1 px border stays, transparent, so nothing moves). They get a faint fill that strengthens on hover and press, 8 px corners, and a 180 ms colour fade that is off under reduced motion.
  - Play becomes ivory-filled and Export becomes a brass outline.
  - lucide icons replace the glyphs only on the two fixed-width buttons: Play/Pause and Zoom to selection.
- **A also adds:** a new test file (TS1–TS6), status Completed on implementation doc 127 and a new doc 128. Everything else in the repository is frozen (974 files). Four mutations prove the tests catch regressions, and the code-reviewer is required.
- **Why only two icons:** I measured the transport in the browser. The old glyphs render in a fallback font (DejaVu Sans), so their size depends on the platform. A 16 px icon would make five buttons 2.8–7.9 px wider or narrower and push their neighbours. The approved rule is that nothing moves, so those buttons wait for V-3b.
- **New layout reference:** I captured the pre-V-3 positions of every control with C's unchanged capture tool. Two runs per viewport matched exactly. C compares against it within ±1 px.
- **New triage item, B-R157-EXPORT-PEAK:** the round-157 demo WAV exports had hundreds to thousands of samples at full scale. Nobody recorded whether the overload warning appeared. C checks this on unchanged audio code. If the samples are there and the warning isn't, it is High and gets fixed before V-3b.

**Decision for Saba: Q-V3-ICON-SIZE** (logged in `feature-status.md`, applies to V-3b)
- (a) 16 px icons as the spec says: the buttons shift by the measured amounts, which needs his approval.
- (b) My default: each icon fills the old glyph's slot (12, 10 or 20 px, same 1 px line weight), so nothing moves.
- (c) A fixed width per button.

V-3b goes ahead with (b) unless he answers first. His other open questions are unchanged.
